name: Past Paper
statement: A does not have any money while B, C and D have. If B gives $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of his to A, C gives $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of his to A and D gives $\dfrac{1}{5}$ of his to A, then the amount given by each of B, C and D are equal and four people altogether have $\mathbb{S}2016$. How much does A have now?
